test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 09 Dec 2022 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate meaning of the underlined idiom in the given sentence.**

After several years of cheating on his PhD work, the candidate finally had to __face the music__ and lose the opportunity.

options.text: Choose another alternative that is uninteresting

solution: The correct answer is option 2), i.e., "To accept unpleasant consequences." [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • Let’s look at the meaning of the given idiom/ phrase: • The idiom **"face the music"** means **to accept the unpleasant consequences of one's actions.** (अपने कार्यों के अप्रिय परिणामों को स्वीकार करना) • In this context, the candidate had been cheating on his PhD work for several years and now he has to accept the unpleasant consequences of his actions and lose the opportunity. • *Example*: • *​**The politician had to **face the music** when his controversial statement went viral on social media.* • Hence, the only possible answer is option 2, 'To accept unpleasant consequences,' which exactly resembles the meaning of the given idiom/ phrase. 1ca:Tc404,
